blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Teacher-free one-step generative models such as W-Flow learn directly from distributional objectives, with the Sinkhorn divergence providing the strongest empirical performance among the energies studied in W-Flow. However, Sinkhorn divergence is based on balanced optimal transport, whose exact marginal constraints can induce undesirable transport under finite minibatch fluctuations. We introduce UW-Flow, which replaces the balanced Sinkhorn energy with a debiased unbalanced Sinkhorn divergence and derives the corresponding Wasserstein velocity. The resulting dynamics retain W-Flow's cross-minus-self structure, recover the balanced limit, and preserve target identifiability under suitable assumptions. We further characterize the finite-batch velocity error of balanced and unbalanced transport by comparing each minibatch field with its population counterpart. Our analysis identifies conditions under which marginal relaxation yields smaller minibatch-to-population velocity error, and shows that for separated matched modes, balanced sensitivity grows with inter-mode separation while the corresponding Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) sensitivity remains controlled by local transport geometry. Controlled experiments on fixed-support and continuous two-mode distributions support these predictions. On MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet-100, UW-Flow improves generation under matched training budgets, with the largest gains in unconditional generation and consistent improvements in the class-conditional setting.
blocks.zh: W-花等无师子的一阶基因模型直接从分布目标中学习,而辛克霍恩分化提供了W-花所研究的能量中最强的经验性能. 然而,辛克霍恩差异是以平衡的最佳运输为基础的,其确切的边际限制在有限的小批量波动下可诱发不良运输。 我们引入了UW-Flow,它将平衡的辛克霍恩能量取而代之的是去偏见的不平衡的辛克霍恩分化并获得相应的瓦瑟斯坦速度. 由此产生的动力学保留了W-Flow的跨减自结构,恢复了平衡的极限,并在合适的假设下保留了目标可识别性. 我们通过将每个小批量区与人口对应区进行比较,进一步描述平衡和不平衡运输的有限-批量速度错误。 我们的分析确定了边际松动产生较小的小型批量对人口速度错误的条件,并表明,对于分离的匹配模式,平衡敏感度随着模式间分离而增加,而相应的不平衡优化运输(UOT)敏感度仍由局部运输几何控制。 固定支撑和连续双模式分布的控制实验支持了这些预测. 在MNIST,CIFAR-10和ImageNet-100上,UW-Flow在相匹配的培训预算下改进了生成,在无条件生成和持续改进课程条件设置方面收获最大.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent progress in teacher-free one-step generative modeling has shown that high-quality generators can be learned directly from distributional objectives ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) . W-Flow ( Han et al., 2026 ) is a representative example that defines a Wasserstein gradient flow from a distributional energy and trains a one-step generator to follow the resulting particle updates. Among the distributional energies studied in W-Flow, the Sinkhorn divergence ( Genevay et al., 2018 ; Feydy et al., 2019 ) achieves the strongest empirical performance.
blocks.zh: 最近在无师一阶基因模型化方面取得的进展表明,高质量的发电机可以直接从分配目标中学习(周等,2025;邓等,2026;韩等,2026. W-Flow(Han等,2026年)是一个代表性的例子,它定义出自分配能的Wasserstein梯度流,并训练出一个单步生成器来跟踪由此产生的粒子更新. 在W-Flow所研究的分布能中,辛克霍恩差异(Genevay等,2018;Feydy等,2019)取得了最强的经验性能.

blocks.en: The Sinkhorn divergence used by W-Flow is built on balanced optimal transport ( Cuturi, 2013 ) , whose coupling must exactly reproduce both input marginals. In practice, however, the corresponding velocity field is estimated from finite minibatches ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2026 ) , whose empirical composition fluctuates from one update to another. Exact marginal matching can therefore force transport between geometrically unrelated regions when, for example, the sampled proportions of different modes do not agree ( Fatras et al., 2021 ; Nguyen et al., 2022 ) . Unbalanced optimal transport (UOT) relaxes these hard marginal constraints through soft penalties ( Liero et al., 2018 ; Chizat et al., 2018 ) , allowing the transported marginals to deviate when exact matching would require undesirable transport. Prior work has shown that such marginal relaxation can improve robustness to minibatch composition mismatch ( Fatras et al., 2021 ; Nguyen et al., 2022 ) and outliers ( Balaji et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: W-Flow使用的Sinkhorn分数基于平衡的最佳运输方式(Cuturi,2013年),其组合必须完全复制两个输入边际. 然而,在实践中,相应的速度场是从有限的小管(Zhu等,2024;Han等,2026)来估计的,其经验成分在一次更新时会波动到另一次更新. 因此,精确的边际匹配可以迫使几何无关区域之间的迁移,例如,不同模式的抽样比例不同意(Fatras等,2021;Nguyen等,2022)。 不平衡的最佳运输(UOT)通过软处罚来放松这些硬边际限制(Liero等,2018;Chizat等,2018),允许所运输的边际在准确匹配需要不理想运输时偏离. 先前的研究表明,这种边际放松可以提高稳健性,以达到小批量成分不匹配的程度(Fatras等人,2021年;Nguyen等人,2022年)和外围点(Balaji等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: Motivated by this, we introduce UW-Flow , which uses the debiased unbalanced Sinkhorn divergence ( Séjourné et al., 2019 ) as its distributional energy, and derive the resulting Wasserstein velocity. In contrast to prior uses of UOT for minibatch objectives ( Fatras et al., 2021 ) , transport maps or couplings ( Yang and Uhler, 2018 ; Choi et al., 2023 ; Eyring et al., 2024 ) , and scalable JKO schemes ( Choi et al., 2024 ) , our formulation uses the debiased unbalanced Sinkhorn divergence as the population energy that directly defines W-Flow’s one-step velocity. In W-Flow, the transport objective directly determines the velocity field used for one-step learning, and thus replacing the balanced Sinkhorn energy changes the underlying population dynamics rather than merely modifying a coupling within a fixed objective. We show that UW-Flow retains the cross-minus-self structure of W-Flow, recovers the balanced dynamics in the hard-marginal limit ( Séjourné et al., 2019 ) , and preserves the desired target-identification property under suitable assumptions. Marginal relaxation therefore defines alternative Wasserstein dynamics while retaining the key structural properties required for distribution matching.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们引入了UW-Flow(UW-Flow),它利用非偏见的不平衡的辛克霍恩分化(Séjourné等,2019年)作为其分配能量,并衍生出由此而来的瓦瑟斯坦速度. 与以往将UOT用于小批量目标(Fatras等,2021年),运输图或耦合(Yang和Uhler等,2018年;Choi等,2023年;Eyring等,2024年)和可扩展JKO计划(Choi等,2024年)不同,我们的配方将去偏见不平衡的Sinkhorn分量作为人口能量,直接定义了W-Flow的一步速度. 在W-Flow中,运输目标直接决定了用于单步学习的速度场,从而取代平衡的Sinkhorn能改变基本的人口动态,而不是仅仅修改固定目标内的接合. 我们显示UW-Flow保留了W-Flow的跨微分自有结构,恢复了硬边际极限的平衡动态(Séjurné等,2019年),并在合适的假设下保留了所期望的目标识别属性. 因此,边际放松定义了替代的Wasserstein动态,同时保留了分配匹配所需的关键结构属性.

blocks.en: We next characterize how finite-batch sampling perturbs the velocity fields induced by balanced and unbalanced transport. Specifically, we measure how far each minibatch velocity deviates from its own population counterpart. For balanced Sinkhorn transport, exact marginal preservation imposes an unavoidable finite-batch velocity error. For UW-Flow, we characterize the leading sensitivity to empirical marginal perturbations and identify conditions under which the UOT minibatch-to-population velocity error is smaller than the corresponding balanced error. In particular, for separated matched modes, the balanced sensitivity grows with inter-mode separation, whereas the corresponding UOT sensitivity remains controlled by the local transport geometry. We further test these predictions on fixed-support and continuous two-mode toy distributions by varying batch size, mode separation, and marginal relaxation.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们描述有限-批采样是如何干扰由平衡和不平衡的运输引起的速度场的。 具体地说,我们衡量每个小批量速度与自己的人口对应速度的相去多远。 对于平衡的Sinkhorn运输来说,精确的边缘保全造成不可避免的有限-批量速度错误。 对于UW-Flow,我们描述经验性边际扰动的主要敏感性,并找出UOT小批量到人口速度出错小于相应均衡出错的条件. 特别是,对于分离的匹配模式,平衡的敏感度随着模式间分离而增加,而相应的UOT敏感度仍由局部运输几何控制. 我们进一步通过不同批量大小、模式分离和边际放松来测试这些关于固定支持和连续双模玩具分布的预测。

blocks.en: We evaluate UW-Flow on MNIST ( LeCun et al., 1998 ) , CIFAR-10 ( Krizhevsky et al., 2009 ) , and ImageNet-100 ( Deng et al., 2009 ; Tian et al., 2020 ) under matched training budgets. The gains are largest in unconditional generation, where multimodal composition mismatch is more substantial, while class-conditional generation also benefits from marginal relaxation.
blocks.zh: 我们根据相应的培训预算,对MNIST(LeCun等人,1998年)、CIFAR-10(Krizhevsky等人,2009年)和ImageNet-100(Deng等人,2009年;Tian等人,2020年)的UW-Flow进行评估。 在无条件的一代人中,收益最大,其中多式联运构成的不匹配程度较高,而有条件的一代人也从边际放松中获益。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Wasserstein gradient flows provide generative models with particle velocities induced by a distributional energy. NSGF ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) studies flows driven by the Sinkhorn divergence, while W-Flow ( Han et al., 2026 ) trains a one-step generator to regress onto the resulting particle updates. Optimal transport (OT) has also been used as a training loss ( Genevay et al., 2018 ) , to construct generators ( Rout et al., 2021 ) , and to pair samples for flow matching ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Pooladian et al., 2023 ) . In W-Flow, the velocity is estimated from balanced minibatch couplings rather than population distributions. Because these couplings must match the sampled marginals exactly, fluctuations in regional sample proportions can alter the transport plan ( Fatras et al., 2019 ; Fatras et al., 2021 ; Nguyen et al., 2021 ; Nguyen et al., 2022 ) and perturb the velocity used as the regression target.
blocks.zh: Wasserstein梯度流提供了由分布能诱发的粒子速度的基因模型. NSGF(Zhu等,2024年)研究由辛克霍恩分流所驱动的流量,而W-Flow(Han等,2026年)则训练出一步生成器以退入所产生的粒子更新. 优化运输(OT)也被用作培训损失(Genevay等,2018年),用于制造发电机(Rout等,2021年),并用于对流匹配的对流样本(Tong等,2024年;Pouladian等,2023年). 在W-Flow中,速度是根据平衡的小批量耦合而不是人口分布来估计的. 由于这些耦合物必须精确地匹配被采样的边际,区域样本比例的波动会改变运输计划(Fatras等,2019;Fatras等,2021;Nguyen等,2021;Nguyen等,2022)并扰动了作为回归目标使用的速度.

blocks.en: Unbalanced transport relaxes exact marginal matching and has been used to improve the robustness of minibatch couplings ( Séjourné et al., 2019 ; Fatras et al., 2021 ) . Related approaches use partial transport to limit mismatched minibatch pairings ( Nguyen et al., 2022 ) , learn maps with reweighted marginals ( Choi et al., 2023 ) , incorporate UOT into flow matching ( Eyring et al., 2024 ) , or formulate scalable JKO-based flows ( Choi et al., 2024 ) . We incorporate an unbalanced Sinkhorn divergence into the W-Flow ( Han et al., 2026 ) framework while retaining the target distribution as an equilibrium of the induced velocity field.
blocks.zh: 运输不均匀可以放松精确的边际匹配,并被用来提高小批量接合的稳健性(Séjourné等,2019;Fatras等,2021). 相关方法采用部分运输方式来限制不匹配的小批量配对(Nguyen等,2022年),用再加权边值来学习地图(Choi等,2023年),将UOT纳入流量匹配(Eyring等,2024年),或形成可伸缩的以JKO为基础的流量(Choi等,2024年). 我们在W-Flow(Han等,2026年)框架中纳入了不平衡的Sinkhorn差异,同时保留目标分布作为被诱发速度场的平衡.

blocks.en: Prior analyses study empirical entropic OT maps ( Rigollet and Stromme, 2025 ; Goldfeld et al., 2024 ) and minibatch OT objectives ( Fatras et al., 2019 ; Fatras et al., 2021 ) . Fatras et al. (2021) also demonstrate minibatch UOT particle flows, but their concentration and gradient results concern the expected minibatch loss. To our knowledge, none directly compares the minibatch-to-population error of the cross-minus-self velocity under balanced and unbalanced marginal constraints. We make this comparison and identify a separated-mode setting in which the leading unbalanced error is smaller.
blocks.zh: 先前的分析研究了实验性北极OT地图(Rigollet and Stromme, 2025;Goldfeld等, 2024)和小型捕猎OT目标(Fatras等, 2019;Fatras等, 2021)。 Fatras等人(2021年)也展示了小批UOT粒子流,但其浓度和梯度结果涉及预期的小批量损失. 据我们所知,在平衡和不平衡的边际限制下,没有人能直接比较跨小区速度对人口的错误。 我们进行这种比较,并找出一个分隔模式设置,其中主要的不平衡错误较小。

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: We first review Wasserstein gradient flows as a framework for defining distributional dynamics and particle updates (Sec. 3.1 ). We then describe how W-Flow instantiates this framework with the balanced Sinkhorn divergence and learns the resulting updates with a one-step generator (Sec. 3.2 ).

6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced UW-Flow to reduce the sensitivity of W-Flow’s velocity field to finite-batch marginal fluctuations. Our analysis characterizes the minibatch-to-population error and identifies a separated-mode setting in which marginal relaxation improves finite-batch stability. Controlled experiments support this analysis, while results on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet-100 show gains in generation quality under finite transport support.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了UW-Flow来降低W-Flow速度场对有限-批量边际波动的敏感性. 我们的分析对小批量与人口之间的误差作了定性,并确定了一种分离的模式设置,其中边际放松可提高小批量的稳定性。 受控制的实验支持这种分析,而关于MNIST、CIFAR-10和ImageNet-100的研究结果显示,在有限的运输支持下,生成质量有所提高。

blocks.en: Our stability comparison measures each minibatch field against its own population field. It does not compare the population velocities of UOT and balanced transport or guarantee better generation for arbitrary distributions. We also do not provide a method for selecting τ \tau for a given setting.
blocks.zh: 我们的稳定性比较 衡量每个小批量场 与自己的人口场。 它不比较UOT的人口速度和均衡的运输,也不保证为任意分配提供更好的生产。 我们也没有为特定设置选择\ tau 的方法 。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: Generative AI tools were used in this work only for two supporting tasks: revising the manuscript for clarity and readability, and proofreading the mathematical derivations for typographical and notational errors. The research itself was carried out by the authors. This includes the idea of using the debiased unbalanced Sinkhorn divergence as the energy for W-Flow, the derivation of the UW-Flow velocity and its identifiability property, the finite-batch error analysis of balanced and unbalanced transport.
